technical.summary: FOXA shows short-term bullish momentum with MACD crossover and price above key moving averages, but weak trend strength (ADX 13.95), overbought stochRSI, and long-term bearish positioning below 200-day MA limit swing entry confidence.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (287.84) indicates extreme market stress, FOMC decision in 2 days creates near-term volatility, and earnings in 43 days add binary event risk to Communication Services sector exposure.
